llm_rerank.name: qwen3-reranker-0.6b
llm_rerank.prompt: model card (transformers example): system 'Judge whether the Document meets the requirements based on the Query and the Instruct provided. Note that the answer can only be "yes" or "no".', user '<Instruct>: {instruction}\n<Query>: {query}\n<Document>: {doc}', assistant prefix with an empty think block
llm_rerank.score: logit(yes) - logit(no) at the last position
llm_rerank.norm: z-score over the top 20 of each topic (final score and reranker score)
llm_rerank.instruction: Given a <domain> conversation, retrieve documents that help answer the current question.
llm_rerank.query: the ReasonEmbed query (current question first, then <= 3 earlier Q/A turns)
